page_title: LEN 2-1 PAR | Lens v Paris FC 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The substitution is prepared. Florian Sotoca (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morgan Guilavogui.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Abdallah Sima (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gael Angoula had an easy-decision to make.
86' The corner kick from Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
86' Alimani Gory (Paris FC) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Paris FC.
84' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) replaces Pierre Lees-Melou.
81' Wesley Said (Lens) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
80' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
74' 8:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
73' Substitution. Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ruben Aguilar walks off.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Florian Thauvin as he is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).
72' Stephane Gilli decides to make a substitution. Adama Camara will be replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC).
71' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
71' Florian Thauvin (Lens) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
70' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Florian Thauvin (Lens), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Lens are awarded a corner kick.
68' The corner is swung in and Samson Baidoo (Lens) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the left post from close in.
68' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) will deliver the corner kick.
64' 2 - 1 Goal! Adrien Thomasson swings the ball deep into the box and finds Samson Baidoo (Lens) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
64' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Florian Thauvin (Lens) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Florian Thauvin (Lens) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
64' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) replaces Jean-Philippe Krasso.
63' It's time for a substitution. Alimani Gory (Paris FC) comes on in place of Moses Simon.
63' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Obed Nkambadio comes off his line to gather the ball.

61' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Paris FC are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
59' Here is a change. Odsonne Edouard is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Wesley Said (Lens).
59' Florian Thauvin (Lens) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
57' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
56' Lens are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. It will be a corner kick for Lens.
55' Hamari Traore (Paris FC) has tested the patience of referee Gael Angoula and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
53' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
52' Moses Simon (Paris FC) will take the corner.

52' Adama Camara (Paris FC) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
46' Stephane Gilli has made a change at the break. Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC) has come on in place of Thibault De Smet.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is about to take a corner kick.
45+3' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
45+1' Florian Thauvin (Lens) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Gael Angoula blows his whistle. Samson Baidoo (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
40' Malang Sarr (Lens) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
39' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
38' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
35' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
32' Matthieu Udol (Lens) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
30' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) neatly controls a decent pass from Ilan Kebbal. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 1:1.

23' Paris FC slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
21' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
21' A pass by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
20' A pass from Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is intercepted by Obed Nkambadio and the move breaks down.
20' Gael Angoula blows his whistle and it's Adama Camara (Paris FC) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

17' 1 - 0 A perfectly taken corner kick. Odsonne Edouard (Lens) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the bottom left corner, increasing the score of today's match – 1:0.
16' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) prepares to take a corner kick.
15' Wonderful movement by Lens. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
9' Florian Thauvin (Lens) blows a huge chance to score! He sends the penalty to the bottom left corner, but it's not enough to beat Obed Nkambadio who easily stops the effort.
9' Referee Gael Angoula is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Lens!
8' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Lens using VAR. Let's see what happens.
8' Gael Angoula shows a yellow card to Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) for his blatant foul.

8' Gael Angoula blows for a foul after Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. The referee gives a penalty to Lens after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
6' Florian Thauvin (Lens) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
6' Florian Thauvin (Lens) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Lens win a corner.
4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC).

4' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Paris FC will have a chance to score from a corner.
3' Robin Risser (Lens) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' Paris FC showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Paris FC.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Paris FC will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Gael Angoula.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
